newsitem.title: USA: Leucadia files for $135 mln debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Leucadia files for $135 mln debt offer.

text.p: Leucadia National Corp filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $135 million in senior subordinated notes due 2006.

Leucadia said net proceeds will be used to buy the 10-3/8 percent notes tendered under a tender offer it launched for all $125 million of the notes at $1,070.00 for each $1,000 principal amount plus accrued interest.
Proceeds in excess of the amount necessary to buy the notes will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said.
The offering will be made through Jefferies & Co Inc and CS First Boston.
